artist.name: Reggae Rajahs
artist.bio: Reggae Rajahs are a reggae sound system of DJs and MCs from New Delhi, formed in 2009 by DJ MoCity, Diggy Dang and Mr Herbalist, who play dub, reggae and dancehall. They ran the weekly show Pressure Drop, later on boxout.fm, started Goa Sunsplash in 2016 and have played Rototom Sunsplash, Sziget and Outlook in Europe.

eras.sound: Dub, reggae and dancehall sound system
